item.title: One Paper Accepted to CHI 2026
item.description:
The paper Can AR Embedded Visualizations Foster Appropriate Reliance on AI in Spatial Decision-Making? A Comparative Study of AR X-Ray vs. 2D Minimap was accepted to the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems.

Congratulations, Carton, Zhu-Tian, and all co-authors!

item.title: Paper Accepted to ACM MIG 2025
item.description:
The paper Enhancing Foveated Rendering with Weighted Reservoir Sampling was accepted to the 18th ACM SIGGRAPH Conference on Motion, Interaction, and Games (MIG ‘25).

Congratulations, Ville!

item.title: Awarded the UMN Doctoral Dissertation Fellowship
item.description: I was awarded the University of Minnesota Doctoral Dissertation Fellowship, a $25,000 fellowship that supports outstanding Ph.D. candidates during the final year of writing their dissertation. Read the department announcement for more details.

item.title: Best Paper Award at IEEE VR 2025
item.description: The paper Peripheral Teleportation: A Rest Frame Design to Mitigate Cybersickness During Virtual Locomotion received the Best Paper Award at IEEE VR 2025, an honor given to the top 1% of all submissions.

item.title: Two Papers Accepted to IEEE VR 2025
item.description:
The paper Peripheral Teleportation: A Rest Frame Design to Mitigate Cybersickness During Virtual Locomotion was accepted as a TVCG paper.

The paper Reduction of Motion Complexity as an Objective Indicator of Cybersickness in Virtual Reality was accepted as a conference paper.

item.title: One Paper And Two 3DUI Contest Entries Accepted to IEEE VR 2024
item.description:
The paper Invisible Mesh: Effects of X-Ray Vision Metaphors on Depth Perception in Optical-See-Through Augmented Reality was accepted to IEEE VR 2024.

Two 3DUI contest entries were accepted to IEEE VR 2024 as well.

item.title: One Paper Accepted to IEEE VR 2023
item.description: The paper Like a Rolling Stone: Effects of Space Deformation During Linear Acceleration on Slope Perception and Cybersickness was accepted to IEEE VR 2023.

item.title: One Workshop Paper Accepted to IEEE VR 2021
item.description: The paper Redirected Tilting: Eliciting Postural Changes with a Rotational Self-Motion Illusion was accepted to IEEE VR 2021 Workshop on Immersive Sickness Prevention (WISP).
